Requirement You are already performing a bio-augment graft or removal on the patient.

When you are already at the table performing a graft or removal on a patient, you may also perform a Load walk-back — pulling a different bio-augment already in them to lower their Load — in the same sitting. The two recoveries run concurrently instead of stacking, so the patient is enfeebled and drained for whichever Grade is higher, not both added together. The walk-back is otherwise an ordinary removal: the pulled tissue is destroyed and its Resonance stays exactly where it was.
